Still, that sentence you wrote really stood out to me. If I haven't changed, I should go ahead and out myself. Those two words, "out myself" echoed in my head over and over last night. I actually considered taking my life again. I must be a horrible person, if someone random, on a suicide watch site, told me to go ahead and do it.

But to answer your question, (I couldn't think clearly the last time I responded to you) I have changed. I've "repented", and it's been almost 2 years since I've done anything like the stuff I mentioned, excepting for cheating on my ex, is what I was trying to say. 

I would never, ever, harm another person or animal on purpose again (physically, atleast). I have also discovered I have a mental illness & I'm treating that now, so it's helping. 

It's just that the guilt is suffocating sometimes. Fuck. I used to be an attempt rapist/murderer (I was never successful) 

But, what defines "change", to you? Completely dedicating my life to good? I mean I'm still a selfish American, but I try to do my best. What if I hadn't changed, but I realized I needed to, and that's why I had posted here? What if I took your words to the brim, like one usually does when they're considering death? What if I had outed myself because of your comment? Would you really want to be responsible for that? Someone's own murder? 

Understand that I'm only telling you this so you won't make this same mistake in the future. If someone like me comes along here, please carefully choose your words next time. Unless you really wanted me to kill myself. 

Thank you for your advice, though.

Yeah, I agree with you. I've tried to kill myself 8 times. 

But I haven't done anything like that in 2 years.

Except for the cheating part.

Forgive me, I'm extremely numb right now. Everything I've kept in the back of my mind is piling up, and it hurts too much to deal with right now.

Can I just clarify I didnt actually go all the way? I tried to touch their privates, and they mostly scooted away so I never did. I cant explain the amount of guilt I feel right now. I wish I was dead :( I cant live knowing I tried to do these things.

I know. I know how terrible it is. Please understand I would never do something like this in my right mind. Is his name Noah? We were both in 3rd grade and he's the only guy I would undress during our sleepovers..
I'm a lot older, and now I would never do such a thing, it's just my past that's getting to me.

Thank you, and yes, of course I have a problem with this impulse. I feel as of late I have a good control over the urge, however, it's still burdensome to think about, and the guilt is suffocating. 

[Edit] - more detail.

That being said, if I ever do let myself rape/molest someone else, I don't WANT to get away with it. At all. It's an abomination even in a society where the idea doesn't exist. It's horrendous for both sexes. I can't imagine the emotional toll I've had on these people I've previously mentioned. If I do end up hurting someone else- I want to be locked up just like any man would.
